questions.q: Let $x, y, z$ be three non-negative integers such that $x+y+z=10$. The maximum possible value of $x y z+x y+y z+z x$ is
questions.solution:
Taking three no's.
$x+1, y+1, z+1\mathrm{AM} \geq \mathrm{GM}$.
$\frac{(x+1)+(y+1)+(z+1)}{3} \geq\{(x+1)(y+1)(z+1)\}^{1 / 3}\left(\frac{13}{3}\right)^{3} \geq x y z+x y+y z+z x+11\left(\frac{13}{3}\right)^{3}-11 \geq x y z+x y+y z+z x$
equality hold when $x=y=z$ but $x+y+z=0$ and $x, y, z$ are integers.
